title: Siri AI is available in more languages starting today
author: Apple Newsroom
content_snippet: With the 27.2 software updates released today, Siri AI is expanding to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
content_full: With the 27.2 software updates released today, Siri AI is expanding to French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
